title: ポップなひつじ
lead: 角の大きな羊や群れを率いる羊など、力強いポップなタッチの羊6点です。未年の年賀状やポスター、ゲーム素材に使えます。
subject_en: ORIGINAL bold stylised sheep with large curled horns and woolly manes, each ONE sheep centred in its cell, cool pop-graphic poster look; no existing character, no brand. Outlines are closed and darker than the fill; light parts (snow, paper, white fur, plates) are warm cream (#FFF6E0) or tinted, never pure white. No letters, no text, no logos.
items: a powerful ram with huge curled horns standing proudly
a sheep leaping in a dynamic pose
a sheep charging forward with lowered horns
a confident sheep standing on a rock, front view
a fluffy sheep with a dramatic woolly mane, side view
